Trim: The Mitsubishi Delica Mini is a kei variation of the Delica series. Replacing the eK X Space on which it was also based, it went on sale in May 2023.[1][2] A second generation arrived in August 2025.

exteriorColors: Mitsubishi had considered naming the car the "Delica D:1", as a continuation of the larger Delica D:5, D:3, and D:2 models, but in the end they opted for "Delica Mini" to tie it to the very successful Pajero Mini instead.[3]

The first-generation Delica Mini was offered in G, G Premium, T, and T Premium grade levels. The "T" models have the turbocharged engine. Announced in late 2022, the Delica Mini went on sale in May 2023 – to coincide with the 55th anniversary of the original Delica.[3]
